newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Banerj auction postponed - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Banerj auction postponed - report.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro state officials indefinitely postponed a scheduled auction Tuesday of state development bank Banerj, Brazil's Invest News reported.
Invest News said Rio de Janeiro's Planning Secretariat suspended the selloff without providing a reason or giving another date for the auction.
Officials at the Secretariat were not immediately available for comment.
Banerj's pension fund and an association of the bank's minority shareholders had united to oppose the privatization, which was to be the first selloff of any Brazilian state bank.
But it was not clear whether their efforts were related to the Secretariat's decision to postpone the auction.
